title: 25 交手一26 交手二27 加入上
content_zh:
“嘿嘿。”
贾彦勇嘿笑着朝林哲羽看来，眼神中不怀好意。
被一个书生偷袭得手，差点瞎了眼睛，让他在帮里失了面子。
这两天里，那些个损友，经常会在他面前晃悠，出言调侃，贾彦勇感觉十分不是滋味。
虽然好勇斗狠，但他没有哥哥贾彦明那么多心思。
贾彦勇有些耿直得过分，被林哲羽偷袭到后，耿直地没有说林哲羽的坏话。
帮派间混战时，耿直地第一个往上冲。
觉得出来混的，义字当头，能为兄弟两肋插刀。
为此被砍伤脖子，差点丢了性命，贾彦勇也没觉得是多大的事。
但失手被一個书生偷袭得手，因此受到损友嘲讽，这就让他十分难受了。
“好！”
林哲羽看了看跃跃欲试，恨不得现在就将他揍一顿的贾彦勇说道。
既然打算加入飞虹帮，那么与贾彦勇的仇怨也该了结了，他们间本就没有什么生死大仇。
能够通过一场对战解决恩怨，他还是十分乐意的。
“哈哈，终于落到我手上了。”
“这次看我不狠狠揍你一顿，找回丢失的场子来。”
贾彦勇咧嘴一笑，看向林哲羽。
明眼人一看，都能发现贾彦勇眼神中的不怀好意。
他扭了扭脖子，一双拳头捏的嘎嘎作响，看得林哲羽都为他的拳头心疼。
“既然同意了，那么贾彦勇你就陪林先生过几招，点到为止，下手不要太重了。”

徐敬武说道。
在他看来，林哲羽虽然练过一些时日武艺，但不会是贾彦勇的对手。
贾彦勇实力达到了锻骨境初期，加上身材壮硕魁梧，实力极为强悍。在飞虹帮中，也算是一名好手了。
“帮主放心，我省的。”
贾彦勇嘿嘿笑着说道，很是高兴。
“这里空间窄小，腾挪不开，我们到后院去。”
林哲羽说道。
他带着徐敬武一行人来到碧丹茶楼后院。
梁松远远地看了他们一眼，继续自顾自地品酒、发呆。
……
来到后院，林哲羽撸起袖子，看着对面的贾彦勇。
贾彦勇看着林哲羽，神色不善：“这次不能使诈偷袭，我看你还有什么本事！”
“娘的，让我在谢江、宁辉两人面前丢了面子，看我不揍的你几天下不来床！”
“喝，看拳！”
贾彦勇说罢，大喝一声，挥着拳头朝林哲羽冲了过去。
他看起来人高马大的，这气势汹汹的一拳，旁人看去都替林哲羽捏了把汗。
“帮主，这样真没事么？”
“要是将林先生打出个好歹，以后就没人说这么精彩的故事了。”
徐敬武身旁，一男子说道。
content_en:
"Hehe."
Jia Yanyong smiled and looked at Lin Zheyu with evil intentions in his eyes.
He was almost blinded by a sneak attack by a scholar, which made him lose face in the gang.
In the past two days, those bad friends would often hang out in front of him and make fun of him, which made Jia Yanyong feel very uncomfortable.
Although he is brave and fierce, he does not have as much thought as his brother Jia Yanming.
Jia Yanyong was a little too upright. After being attacked by Lin Zheyu, he was upright and did not say anything bad about Lin Zheyu.
When there is a scuffle between gangs, be upright and be the first to rush up.
I feel that those who come out to hang out have a sense of righteousness and can help their brothers.
Jia Yanyong was stabbed in the neck and almost lost his life because of this, but Jia Yanyong didn't think it was a big deal.
But he was accidentally attacked by a scholar, so he was ridiculed by his bad friends, which made him very uncomfortable.
"Okay!"
Lin Zheyu looked at Jia Yanyong who was eager to give him a try and wanted to beat him up now and said.
Since he planned to join the Feihong Gang, it was time to settle his grudge with Jia Yanyong. There was no life-or-death feud between them.
He was very happy to be able to resolve his grudges through a battle.
"Haha, it finally fell into my hands."
"Let's see if I don't give you a good beating this time and regain the lost place."
Jia Yanyong grinned and looked at Lin Zheyu.
Anyone with a discerning eye can spot the malicious intent in Jia Yanyong's eyes.
He twisted his neck and made a clenching sound with his fists, which made Lin Zheyu feel distressed for his fists.
"Since you agree, Jia Yanyong, you will go through a few tricks with Mr. Lin until the point is reached, and don't strike too hard."
Xu Jingwu said.
In his opinion, although Lin Zheyu had practiced some martial arts, he would not be Jia Yanyong's opponent.
Jia Yanyong's strength has reached the early stage of Bone Forging Realm, and with his strong and tall body, he is extremely powerful. He is also considered a good player in the Feihong Gang.
"Don't worry, Gang Leader, I saved it."
Jia Yanyong said with a smile, very happy.
"The space here is small and we can't move around. Let's go to the backyard."
Lin Zheyu said.
He took Xu Jingwu and his party to the backyard of Bidan Tea House.
Liang Song glanced at them from a distance and continued to drink wine and be in a daze by himself.
…
Arriving in the backyard, Lin Zheyu rolled up his sleeves and looked at Jia Yanyong opposite.
Jia Yanyong looked at Lin Zheyu with an unkind expression: "You can't use deceit to attack this time. Let me see what else you can do!"
"Damn it, let me lose face in front of Xie Jiang and Ning Hui. If I don't beat you up, you won't be able to get out of bed for a few days!"
"Drink and watch the punches!"
After Jia Yanyong said this, he shouted loudly and rushed towards Lin Zheyu with his fists waving.
He looked tall and powerful, and others were sweating for Lin Zheyu when they saw this powerful punch.
"Gang Leader, is this really okay?"
"If Mr. Lin is beaten, no one will tell such wonderful stories in the future."
Next to Xu Jingwu, a man said.
